pfalz: Pfalz is a territory in southwestern Germany formerly ruled by the counts palatine.
Pfalz means the same as Palatinate.
pfannkuchen: Pfannkuchen is puffy mildly sweet lemon-flavored egg mixture sprinkled with confectioners' sugar and served with jam or a wine or fruit sauce.
Pfannkuchen means the same as german pancake.
pfc: PFC is a powerful greenhouse gas emitted during the production of aluminum.
PFC means the same as perfluorocarbon.
pfennig: Pfennig is 100 pfennigs formerly equaled 1 Deutsche Mark in Germany.
pflp: PFLP is a terrorist group of limited popularity formed in 1967 after the Six-Day War.
PFLP means the same as Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine.
pflp-gc: PFLP-GC is a Marxist-Leninist terrorist organization that conducted several attacks in western Europe.
PFLP-GC means the same as Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine-General Command.
